visual.general_description: Wide genome-wide copy-number plot with grey dots along chromosomes 1 to 22, X and Y and a printed header line.
visual.detailed_description: A wide plot with a printed header line "MAPD=0.193 Productive Read Count=122453 Confidence filter=0.1 Filter Chain=Aneuploidy Mosaicism". The y axis is numbered from 0.5 to 4.5 in steps of 0.5, with horizontal gray lines at 1 and 3, and the x axis is labeled with chromosomes 1 to 22, X and Y in alternating gray and white bands. A thin yellow horizontal line lies at 2, and grey dots track close to it across all chromosomes, with small dips below it over parts of chromosomes 7, 11, 14, 19 and X and small rises above it over parts of chromosomes 5, 16 and 18. No dots appear for Y. No panel letters.
